meta.title: Conversation find
meta.description: Press Ctrl+F (Cmd+F on macOS) in a session to search the conversation transcript. Shows an Office-style find panel with all matches listed; every match is highlighted in place, and Previous, Next, or clicking a result jumps to it exactly. Desktop defaults to Ctrl+F / Cmd+F (Web uses Ctrl+Alt+F), Escape or ✕ closes the panel.

find.noSession: Open a session to search its conversation
